aboutAnEndedOrder: About an order no longer in force
aboutAnEndedOrderOn: About an order no longer in force, ended {{stopDate}}
aboutAnEndedOrderTitle: The chart records this drug only as an order no longer in force, so the finding is about what giving it again would mean — not about a medication the patient is taking now.
activeOrderClaimsUncited: {{uncited}} of {{stated}} statements about active orders cite no chart record.
aiDisclaimer: This answer is AI-generated and may not be accurate.
aiDisclaimerText: This response is AI-generated and may not be accurate. It is not a substitute for clinical judgment. Always verify against the patient's medical records.
alreadyPrescribedTitle: The patient has an active order for this drug, so this finding is about a medication already prescribed, not one being proposed. The drug shown is the substance the module matched that order to, which the order itself may name differently — a brand name, for example.
askChartSearchAgainNote: ChartSearch answers from this chart using AI. It isn’t asked again when this page is reopened.
caveatMisattributed: This citation can’t be the active order the answer names.
caveatUnfaithful: The answer’s wording of this citation isn’t the record’s wording.
caveatUnstatedSeverity: The answer doesn’t state this finding’s rating.
chartSearchSignedOut: Your session has ended. Log in again, then ask again.
citationAttached: Added by ChartSearch from a safety finding
citationNotSupported: The record may not support this statement
citationSubset: Shows some of this entry’s interaction partners
citedReference: Reference material, not this patient’s record
conditionRulesAbsent: The patient’s recorded conditions weren’t screened against contraindication rules: the loaded drug reference has none.
drugClassNoteCitation: A note about a drug class the question named — not this patient’s record.
drugReferenceCitation: Clinical reference data — not this patient’s record.
microphonePermissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Please allow microphone permissions.
misattributedCitationTitle: The module reports that this citation may not be the medication order this sentence names, so it is not offered as a link. This is a report about the citation, not a verdict on the safety finding.
modelReasoningCaveat: The model’s working notes, not the answer. Nothing here was checked against the chart, and it can state things the answer does not.
notAboutTheDrugAsked_one: {{count}} finding not about the drug asked about
notAboutTheDrugAsked_other: {{count}} findings not about the drug asked about
notGroundedTitle: The cited record may not support this statement — verify against the chart.
notInTheAnswerTitle: The answer does not mention this finding. It relates the drug asked about to another drug the question names; open the detail to read it in full.
orderStopDateTitle: The date this prescription stopped being in force — not the record’s own date shown beside it.
otherMedicationFindings_one: {{count}} finding about another of this patient’s medications
otherMedicationFindings_other: {{count}} findings about other medications this patient takes
referenceMaterialCitation: Module-supplied reference material — not this patient’s record.
rewordedInTheAnswerTitle: The answer cites this finding at {{markers}} and reworded it: it reproduces the record and then says something different inside the same sentence. Open the detail to compare it with the record’s own words.
safetyChecksCitedInTheAnswer_other: {{count}} findings, each cited in the answer
safetyFindingCitation: The module’s own safety finding, computed from this patient’s chart — not a chart record to open.
seeMarkerInTheAnswerTitle: The answer cites this finding at that marker, and no check of how it was rendered named it, so its detail is collapsed rather than repeated. The answer may still word it differently, leave part of it out or leave out its rating, which this line states; open the detail to read the finding in full.
seeMarkerInTheModulesAnswerTitle: The answer states this finding briefly at that marker; open the detail to read it in full.
sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
significanceUnknownTitle: The finding this cites says the clinical significance of the interaction is unknown. The answer leaves that out.
sourceOfFindingOpensTitle: The chart record the cited safety finding is based on. Click to read that finding.
sourceOfFindingsTitle: The chart record the cited safety finding is based on. The answer has no marker for it, since it cites the finding; opening it goes to the record.
speechRecognitionError: Speech recognition failed. Please try again.
statedAboveByTheModuleTitle: The module states this finding after the answer; open the detail to read it in full.
unresolvedDrugClass: The question names a drug class, “{{drugClass}}”. Reference entries are listed by individual drug, so the class wasn’t matched to any of them. Ask about a specific drug by name.
unsourcedAnswer: This answer is hidden because it didn’t cite any records.
unstatedSeverityTitle: Rated by the reference dataset. This answer may not state the rating — it is shown here so the findings can be ranked.
unsupportedEndedOrderClaim_one: No record says the {{drugs}} order has ended — the answer states it without one.
unsupportedEndedOrderClaim_other: No record says the {{drugs}} orders have ended — the answer states it without one.
unsupportedEndedOrderClaimTitle: The answer says this order is no longer in force, but none of the records the answer was built from marks it that way. Check the patient’s medication list before relying on it.
utcCalendarDayTitle: The date is a calendar day in UTC, so it can be a day off the local date.
